newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks finish strongly, led by blue chips.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks finish strongly, led by blue chips.

text.p: Tokyo stocks sprinted higher on Monday to end with gains of nearly two percent after finishing May on a negative note.
Buying interest in blue-chip issues and futures was especially strong throughout the day, although trade was thin, brokers said.
The Nikkei average added 383.04 points, or 1.91 percent, to close at 20,451.85. June Nikkei futures rose 300 to 20,440.
"Eyes are still on Sony Corp and NTT, which are the market leaders," said Akihiro Naemura, Okasan Securities general manager. "But investors need more motivation to push the shares to new heights."
